notes: Match dates and kick-off times were extracted from FIFA's official FWC26 match schedule PDF.
The official PDF publishes kick-off times in Eastern Time (ET).
Local kick-off dates/times in this file were derived by converting the official ET kickoff to each host venue timezone.
Laravel seeders normalize every match to Europe/Amsterdam for match_date, kickoff_at_local and timezone_name while preserving kickoff_at_utc.
